title: Product Manager
description:
**Company:**
------------

Qualcomm India Private Limited

**Job Area:**
-------------

Operations Group, Operations Group > Product Management

**General Summary:**

Directs a comprehensive product strategy from product conception and definition through end of life. Functions as a central resource with design, process, manufacturing, quality, test, marketing, and distribution as the product(s) and/or product line(s) move through their lifecycle. Formulates and executes long-term roadmaps for cost/profit control. Promotes use of new technologies and industry-leading trends. Directs those involved in the design, modification, and evaluation of all phases of a specific product or group of products. Involvement lasts throughout all stages of a product’s lifecycle including modifications, upgrades, and maintenance of the product or product line.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or technical related field.
* 2+ years of Product Management or related work experience.

  

* Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of Product Management or related work experience.

* 1+ year of working in a large matrixed organization.

* 1+ year of working with operating budgets and/or project financials.

* 1+ year of negotiating 3rd party business agreements.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Conducts analyses to assess marketability of products based on market, customer, technology, and other ecosystem demands.

* Serves as a market and business advisor in the formation of a business case for the development of a new product or product features (i.e., time to market, cost, market share).

* Drives the launch efforts of products and technologies for own area of responsibility by staying up to date on technological developments and customer needs through direct customer contact.

* Seeks out market information and displays an understanding of the marketplace to contribute to the product roadmap.

* Directs the development of moderately complex products and services under some supervision and communicates with individuals across functional teams.

* Completes product development and definition activities including determination of cost and impact, and interacts with sales team to generate forecasts.

* Stays up to date on competitors, technological advances, and product ecosystem and supports the development and design of new products.

* Maintains effective communication within own team and cross-functional team(s) on the management of a single product.

* Ensures successful cross-functional collaboration by ensuring that agreed upon KPIs and specifications are met for a single product, upon delivery by engineering team.
* Supports the establishment of product goals (e.g., performance, cost, timeline) and collaborates with others to execute tasks based on established goals.

**Level of Responsibility:**

* Working under some supervision.

* Making decisions that are low to moderate in impact; errors may have relatively minor financial impact or effect on projects, operations, or customer relationships; errors may require involvement beyond immediate work group to correct.

* Using verbal and written communication skills to convey information that may be somewhat complex to others who may have limited knowledge of the subject in question. May require basic negotiation and influence, cooperation, tact, and diplomacy, etc.

* Completing tasks with multiple steps that can be performed in various orders; some planning and prioritization must occur to complete the tasks effectively; mistakes may result in some rework.

* Exercising creativity to draft original documents, imagery, or work products within established guidelines.

* Using deductive and inductive problem solving; multiple approaches may be taken/necessary to solve the problem; often information is missing or incomplete; intermediate data analysis/interpretation skills may be required.

The responsibilities of this role do not include:

* Financial accountability (e.g., does not involve budgeting responsibility).

* Influence over key organizational decisions.

* Role in strategic planning.

description:

Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

This role reports to the Manager, Software Engineering, within Global Procurement Technology at the India Technology Center (ITC) in Bangalore.

The ITC team supports global procurement and corporate functions, enabling NIKE to operate efficiently and at scale across regions. As the lead technical program manager for indirect procurement, you will own the end-to-end program strategy for Source-to-Pay (S2P) solutions and coach TPMs who execute roadmaps for individual product areas.

Successful delivery and operational excellence in this role depend on close collaboration with:

* Senior TPMs, software engineers, architects, analysts, and business partners across indirect procurement products such as Coupa, Tririga, Beeline, Concur, Aravo, and related SaaS platforms
* Core ERP teams (SAP S/4HANA, ECC, and Oracle) covering accounts payable, tax, and related domains
* Engineering, security, and enterprise architecture partners
* External SaaS vendors and technology partners
  

  
  

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are seeking a seasoned technical program leader with deep expertise in procurement processes and platforms, particularly integrating sourcing and procurement SaaS with SAP (ECC and S/4HANA). The successful candidate combines hands-on S2P and P2P knowledge with proven ability to define multi-horizon roadmaps, lead TPMs, and influence senior business and technology stakeholders in a global enterprise.

  

In this role, you will own product vision and roadmap articulation, portfolio prioritization, program governance, and delivery cadence across scrum teams. You will facilitate workshops and design discussions at the portfolio level, validate requirements and solution approaches, mentor senior and junior TPMs, and partner with procurement leadership to deliver scalable, audit-ready capabilities worldwide.

  

This position is based in Bangalore, India. We welcome applications from candidates currently residing in Bangalore as well as those willing to relocate.
  
**Required Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years in software engineering, technical program management, or product delivery with a strong focus on procurement processes and platforms, including hands-on experience integrating multiple indirect procurement tools with SAP (ECC and S/4HANA).
* Demonstrated leadership of TPMs or cross-functional delivery teams across P2P and S2P products, SaaS-based procurement systems, and ERP master and transactional data flows.
* Expertise in integration strategy—source-to-target mapping, payload design, transformations, and patterns spanning APIs, events, batch/file, and middleware—with ability to guide architects and engineers.
* Proficiency with portfolio and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Lucid (or equivalents); experience defining prioritization frameworks and operating rhythms for global programs.
* Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to synthesize complex technical and process topics for business, engineering, and vendor audiences.
* Comfort leading in a fast-paced, results-oriented, global environment with competing priorities and ambiguous problem spaces.
* Strong collaboration skills and a growth mindset: you develop others, model curiosity, and drive continuous improvement across teams and vendors.
  

**WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON**

* You will define and communicate the vision and roadmap for enterprise Source-to-Pay and procurement technology that supports Nike's global indirect procurement operations.
* You will lead portfolio-level prioritization with procurement, finance, and technology leaders—balancing demand, risk, cost, and capability—and drive decisions to clear commitments.
* You will translate strategic intent into phased delivery plans, success metrics, and well-scoped backlogs, guiding teams on out-of-the-box SaaS use versus justified extensions.
* You will mentor and develop TPMs and senior engineers on delivery execution, stakeholder engagement, and program governance.
* You will partner with ERP, security, enterprise architecture, and external SaaS vendors to align solutions with Nike standards, integration patterns, and long-term platform direction.
* You will establish program health metrics, release readiness criteria, and escalation paths so teams deliver predictably across regions.
* You will anticipate regulatory, audit, and operational needs (e.g., SOX, data residency, vendor SLAs) and embed them in roadmap planning.

NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete\* in the world.

NIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

What You Can Expect

**OUR HIRING GAME PLAN**
------------------------

### **01 Apply**

Our teams are made up of diverse skillsets, knowledge bases, inputs, ideas and backgrounds. We want you to find your fit – review job descriptions, departments and teams to discover the role for you.

### **02 Meet a Recruiter or Take an Assessment**

If selected for a corporate role, a recruiter will reach out to start your interview process and be your main contact throughout the process. No matter the role, we want to learn about you – the whole you – so don’t shy away from how you approach world-class service and what makes you unique.

### **03 Interview**

Go into this stage confident by doing your research, understanding what we are looking for and being prepared for questions that are set up to learn more about you, and your background.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

We provide growth opportunities, empowering Product Managers to direct high-visibility programs and strategic integrations alongside talented peers. Join us to solve tests and impact Google Cloud's commerce platform.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

* Lead the product roadmap for core ordering systems, modernizing and automating Google Cloud's Quote-to-Cash life-cycle across offline and online flows.
* Design and execute end-to-end orchestration workflows for product provisioning and manage platform primitives for entitlement life-cycles and usage integration metrics.
* Drive cross-functional alignment with engineering, sales operations, and boundary product groups to support commercial transaction flows and downstream systems like sales compensation, billing, and business recognition.
* Serve as the Subject Matter Expert and advocate for process/system discipline in ordering, booking, and fulfillment for your supported line of business.
* Lead end-to-end initiatives across Quote-to-Cash and GCBP overall.

description:
**About the Role:**

We're looking for a hands-on Product Manager with 4–8 years of experience building consumer internet products, ideally mobile-first apps where user engagement, retention, and growth are central to the business.

At FOXO, you'll work directly with the founders, designers, engineers, doctors, and business teams to identify consumer problems, shape product direction, and take ideas from discovery to launch. You'll use customer insights and data to make decisions, improve user experiences, and drive measurable product outcomes.

This isn't a role where you'll inherit a mature roadmap. You'll help build one. We're looking for someone with strong product judgment, an analytical mindset, and the ability to execute independently in a fast-moving startup environment.

**What You'll Do:**

* **Own product initiatives end to end:** Drive problem discovery, prioritization, development, launch, and post-launch improvements.
* **Build great mobile experiences:** Improve onboarding, navigation, user journeys, and the overall experience of using a consumer app.
* **Understand consumer behaviour:** Use customer interviews, feedback, behavioural data, and competitive research to identify opportunities.
* **Drive product direction:** Work with the founders to shape the roadmap and prioritize problems based on customer needs and business impact.
* **Partner with Design and Engineering:** Translate problems into clear user flows, product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* **Use data to drive decisions:** Analyse funnels, cohorts, activation, engagement, and retention to identify drop-offs and opportunities for improvement.
* **Experiment and iterate:** Test ideas, evaluate outcomes, and continuously improve the product based on evidence.
* **Drive execution:** Make trade-offs, resolve bottlenecks, coordinate releases, and maintain a high bar for product quality.
* **Collaborate across teams:** Work with doctors and business teams to translate domain expertise into useful consumer experiences.
* **Explore AI opportunities:** Identify where AI can meaningfully improve the user experience or solve a real consumer problem.

**What We're Looking For:**

Must Have

* 4–8 years of hands-on Product Management experience, preferably in B2C or consumer internet.
* Experience at a consumer internet company building products used directly by consumers, where engagement, retention, or growth mattered.
* Strong understanding of mobile app fundamentals, including onboarding, user journeys, navigation, funnels, and repeat usage.
* Demonstrated ownership of product initiatives from discovery through launch and subsequent iteration.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use product data and customer insights to make decisions.
* Ability to break down ambiguous problems into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong product sense and attention to detail, with an understanding of the trade-offs between user experience, business outcomes, and engineering effort.
* Ability to work directly with founders, make decisions with incomplete information, and drive projects independently.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* A bachelor's degree from a Tier-I college or other leading undergraduate institution.

* Experience improving activation, conversion, engagement, retention, or other core consumer product metrics.
* Experience building mobile apps in health, wellness, lifestyle, fintech, commerce, or other consumer-focused categories.

* Working knowledge of SQL.
* Familiarity with Figma, Jira, Notion, and AI-powered productivity tools.
* Experience with AI/LLM-powered products. Prior AI experience is not a requirement.

* **Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
* **Work Model:** Full-time, on-site at FOXO's Bengaluru office.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Identifying high-impact consumer problems and turning them into simple, intuitive product experiences.
* Shipping quality mobile experiences with minimal supervision.
* Improving activation, engagement, retention, and other meaningful product metrics.
* Making product decisions grounded in customer behaviour, data, and sound judgment.
* Taking ownership of outcomes rather than simply delivering features.

description:
**EXCLUSIVE NETWORKS** | **Introduction**

Exclusive Networks is the global cybersecurity go-to-market specialist that provides partners and end-customers with a wide range of services and product portfolios. With offices in over 45 countries and the ability to serve customers in over 170 countries, we combine deep local expertise with the scale and delivery of a single global organization.

Our best-in-class vendor portfolio is carefully curated with all leading industry players. Our services range from managed security to specialist technical accreditation and training and capitalize on rapidly evolving technologies and changing business models. For more information visit www.exclusive-networks.com.

At Exclusive Networks, we are passionate about making a difference. That means delivering the best to our ecosystem, shaping a prosperous and trusted digital world, and helping our people to realize their full potential.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** | **About the role**

The Product Manager is responsible for driving profitable business growth by managing the complete sales lifecycle—from lead qualification to closure—while ensuring strong pipeline hygiene, partner engagement, and alignment with vendor expectations

This role will report to the Business Unit Head

**As the Product Manager, you will:**

1. Sales Pipeline and Funnel Management

* Develop, maintain, and manage a qualified 3X sales funnel aligned with vendor-assigned revenue targets.
* Conduct bi-weekly pipeline reviews with vendor teams to ensure alignment on progress and forecasts.
* Oversee accurate and timely deal registrations, opportunity tracking, and reporting.

2. Lead Management and Customer Engagement

* Qualify leads generated through cold outreach, inbound inquiries, and partner referrals.
* Independently present vendor solutions to prospects, involving senior or technical stakeholders only for executive-level or strategic accounts.

3. Proposal and Solution Support

* Prepare and oversee the creation of competitive quotations and proposals.
* Coordinate proof-of-concepts (POCs), demo units, and other pre-sales engagements to support solution validation.

4. Partner and Vendor Management

* Manage key stakeholders within the business line to ensure effective collaboration and execution.
* Identify, develop, and nurture Focus Partners to drive mutual growth.
* Deliver partner enablement sessions, including updates and training programs.

5. Marketing Collaboration

* Establish measurable objectives for marketing investments and initiatives.
* Collaborate with internal marketing teams and external partners to plan and execute joint campaigns effectively.

6. Certifications and Compliance

**About Solifi**

Solifi deliver a solid financial technology foundation for equipment, working capital, wholesale, and automotive finance firms. At Solifi, we believe that commerce is only as strong as the system it runs on. Our mission is to reshape finance technology by bringing together proven solutions into a singular powerful technology platform designed to help protect and scale financial organizations. We guard our customers by being precise and reliable, we guide their success by combining powerful technology with proven expertise, and we help them grow by unleashing their potential.

  

**About the Team**

We are a small, high ownership AI team operating with the pace and ownership of a startup within a global enterprise. We build production grade AI products that are used by real customers, taking ideas from early experimentation and prototyping through evaluation, production deployment and continuous improvement. The team brings together AI product management, AI engineering and data expertise, with a strong emphasis on shipping, experimentation, quality and measurable customer outcomes. We work closely with product, engineering and domain teams across the business to identify where AI can create meaningful value and then build the systems required to deliver it reliably at scale. This is an opportunity to work on some of the core AI products shaping how modern AI is applied within enterprise software, while having significant influence over what we build, how we evaluate it and how AI products are built and operated in production.

  

**About the Position**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager - AI to lead the development of production grade AI products that solve complex problems for enterprise customers.
  
  
This is a highly hands on product role for someone who understands that building AI products is fundamentally different from building traditional software. You will work at the intersection of product, data, AI, and domain expertise, with significant ownership over both the product outcome and the process used to prove that the AI system can reliably deliver it.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will not simply manage a backlog of AI features or translate requirements between customers and engineering. You will be expected to understand the problem, formulate the hypothesis, work with the data, determine how AI can solve it, establish how success will be measured, validate the solution and drive it all the way into production.
  
  
The goal is not to build AI for the sake of using AI. The goal is to build reliable, production-grade AI products that create measurable value for enterprise customers.

  

**Role and Responsibilities**

Identify high value customer problems, develop hypotheses around where AI can create measurable value and validate those hypotheses using data, experimentation and customer feedback.
  
  
Work hands on with large and complex datasets to understand the problem, identify patterns, test assumptions, and determine what is required to build an effective AI solution.
  
  
Partner with AI engineering and data teams to design AI powered product experiences, including grounding and retrieval systems, prompts, model selection, orchestration and AI workflows.
  
  
Build and own AI evaluation frameworks, including evaluation datasets, golden sets, test cases, metrics, automated evaluations, and human evaluation processes.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability for production systems and use evaluation and production data to identify failures, understand root causes and continuously improve the product.
  
  
Drive AI capabilities from prototype and proof of concept through production deployment, customer adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
Define and measure the product and AI metrics that demonstrate whether the system is delivering the intended customer outcome.

  

**About You**

What We Are Looking For: • 7+ years of product management experience, with significant experience building and shipping B2B software products. • Strong hands-on experience building AI-powered products, where AI is a core part of the product experience and customer outcome. • Deep practical understanding of AI evaluation and experience building evaluation frameworks for AI products. • Strong experience with AI monitoring and observability, including identifying, diagnosing, and addressing failures in production AI systems. • Strong data skills and experience working with large-scale data. You should be comfortable understanding data structures, exploring datasets, analyzing data, and using data to validate product hypotheses and AI behavior. • Experience designing and building grounding systems and evaluation systems, rather than simply consuming AI APIs. • Experience with modern AI application architectures, including LLMs, RAG, embeddings, prompting, model selection, agents/workflows, and orchestration. • Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous problem, formulate hypotheses, validate them with data and experimentation, and turn the resulting insight into a production product. • Experience building products for B2B customers in heavily regulated industries, such as financial services, fintech, insurance, healthcare, or similar domains. • Strong understanding of enterprise AI considerations including accuracy, reliability, explainability, security, governance, data quality, and auditability. • Ability to work deeply with technical teams and engage in detailed discussions about AI system behavior without needing to be the engineer implementing the system. • Familiarity with the AWS ecosystem is preferred. • Strong product judgment and the ability to distinguish between an impressive AI demo and an AI system that is genuinely reliable enough for production use. What Will Set You Apart: • You have taken an AI product from hypothesis prototype evaluation production continuous monitoring and improvement. • You have personally designed or owned an AI evaluation framework and understand why evaluation is central to building reliable AI products. • You have worked through difficult AI failure modes and know how to investigate whether a problem originates in the model, data, retrieval, grounding, prompting, orchestration, or product workflow. • You have experience building AI products where incorrect outputs have meaningful business or customer consequences. • You are comfortable challenging an initial hypothesis when the data or evaluations do not support it. • You naturally think in terms of measurable customer outcomes rather than AI features. • You enjoy getting into the details and are equally comfortable discussing a customer workflow, analyzing an evaluation dataset, investigating AI output failures, and working with engineers on the product architecture.

Robotics foundation models need millions of hours of dense, real-world data—and simulation alone won't cut it. TELUS Digital is solving the Physical AI bottleneck, capturing highly calibrated, real-world data at scale across hundreds of devices to power the world's leading hyperscalers.

We are hiring a **Group Product Manager** for the **Physical AI Robotics product team**. You will own the tooling this runs on: capture applications, operator workflows, session management, review and QA, and customer delivery. **About the Role**  
Messaging is where marketing actually meets the customer — the push that gets opened, the WhatsApp that gets replied to, the SMS that drives the click. You'll own a slice of the Campaigns product — the engine behind messaging across Push, Email, SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, and In-App channels — and be judged on whether customers actually adopt what you ship, not on how well you followed the spec someone else wrote.  
You're a few years into your PM career, not new to it. You've shipped things end-to-end, learned what "done" actually means in practice, and know the difference between a feature customers use every day and a feature that only exists in a release note.  
You'll report into the Campaigns product team, work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design, and spend a meaningful chunk of your week talking to customers, reading support threads, and digging through usage data — because that's where the real opportunities live, not in a brainstorm.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* **Customer Research, Relentlessly-** Run structured VoC/VoP analysis — customer calls, support ticket audits, CSM conversations, in-app feedback — to build a constantly-updated picture of where Campaigns is winning and where it's losing deals or trust. Turn scattered anecdotes into a ranked list of real problems.
* **Opportunity Mining-** Don't wait for a PRD to land in your inbox. Mine support channels, churn signals, and feature requests to surface the 2-3 gaps that matter most this quarter — and defend why those and not the other twenty.
* **Execution, End to End-** From decision-anchored PRD to shipped feature — write the spec, resolve edge cases, sit in every standup that matters, unblock engineering, and make trade-off calls when scope and timeline collide. Ideas are cheap; shipped is the job.
* **Adoption Is the Metric-** Shipping isn't done at code-complete. Partner with CS, Sales, and Marketing to drive activation — enablement decks, in-app nudges, customer outreach — and own the adoption number, not just the release note.
* **Voice of the Customer, Internally-** Be the translator between "what customers are saying" and "what we build next." Feed structured research back into prioritization debates and hold the team accountable to solving the problem, not just the ticket.

**What we're looking for**

* 3+ years of product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment.

This charter sits at the intersection of machine learning, real-time decisioning, and customer lifecycle strategy - and is responsible for determining which customers to engage, with what action, at what moment, and through which channel.  
  
You will lead the technical integration of our rewards optimization, causal measurement, and action intelligence systems onto a unified agentic orchestration platform - enabling faster experimentation, more personalized interventions, and greater operational efficiency across all our emerging locales.

* Drive quarterly planning and prioritization across a portfolio of integrations, balancing technical debt, engineering capacity, and business impact

description:
**Overview**

Role: **Senior Product Manager**

Build the commerce engine that powers Copilot's growth.

Every great growth idea, a new offer, a smarter trial, a better upgrade, ends in the same place: a purchase that has to feel effortless and work flawlessly, on every device. You will own the commerce foundations behind Copilot, so that anyone who chooses to pay gets instant access to what they bought, and growth teams can turn a new idea into a live offer in days. This is a growth role disguised as a platform role: the systems you build decide how fast the whole organization can learn.

Why this role, why now

Copilot recently came together as one app across web, desktop and mobile, for consumers and businesses alike. Monetization is moving inside the product, with new plans, add-ons and usage-based offers arriving quickly. Early signals on mobile are solid, and in-app purchase is live across iOS and Android. That makes commerce one of the highest-leverage places to build right now.

How we work

* Small, empowered mission teams with clear ownership.
* Every bet starts with a written hypothesis, is measured rigorously, and decisions are made on evidence.
* AI-native by default: we use AI agents and tools throughout our own workflow to research, prototype, analyze and ship faster.
* Ship fast, learn faster, scale what works.
* India shapes global strategy here, not just execution.

You'll thrive here if…

* You sweat the details of a great purchase moment.
* You know revenue is won or lost in receipts, retries, renewals and edge cases.
* You read API contracts like specs and write your own queries instead of waiting for dashboards.
* You can sketch the state machine for a purchase across store, service and app.
* You move teams you don't manage with clear asks, crisp escalations and a lot of goodwill.
* You form a view, test it and change your mind when the data says so.

This role may not be for you if…

* You want a fully defined backlog handed to you every cycle.
* You prefer strategy decks to working through a tricky purchase flow with engineers.
* Ambiguity across many partner teams drains you rather than motivates you.

Why join us

Few roles give you this much leverage: the commerce foundations you build will shape how millions of people and businesses buy and experience AI. You will own a critical platform for a global product, with the trust to set direction and a fast-moving, AI-native team beside you. If that excites you, we would love to meet you.

* App store billing: purchase, renewal and receipts on iOS, Android and Mac, in close partnership with store platforms.
* Usage and recovery: usage-based metering and smooth payment recovery.
* Measurement everywhere: telemetry and experimentation hooks so every commerce change is measured.

You will partner with platform, engineering, finance, tax, legal and store teams, and move metrics such as purchase success, time to access, checkout conversion and experiment lead time.

* First 30 days: understand every purchase path end to end, and the data and partners behind it.
* By 60 days: a hypothesis-led commerce roadmap your partners back.
* By 90 days: a first improvement shipped, and a growth team launching an offer on your foundations.

* Bachelor's Degree AND 6+ years experience in product management or software development.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Significant experience with commerce, payments, billing, subscriptions or platform products at scale.
* Solid technical depth: API contracts, data schemas, SQL and purchase edge cases.

title: Sr. Product Manager I - Data Mesh
description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it's what we show up for every day.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own DataMesh, one of Smartsheet's most widely used cross-sheet data capabilities and a critical part of how enterprise customers build and run their solutions today. DataMesh sits at the centre of a multi-year shift in Smartsheet's data model, as we evolve towards column links and, ultimately, relational data capabilities.

**You Will:**

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for DataMesh, balancing near-term stability and customer needs against the longer-term migration strategy
* Own the operational stability and serviceability of DataMesh, partnering with engineering and Support to prioritise defects, performance issues, and escalations
* Shape and execute the migration path from DataMesh to column links, working closely with the Data Links PM on feature parity, the advanced column links roadmap, and report-as-a-source as a critical dependency
* Lead customer and user discovery with enterprise personas (work admins, solution builders, system administrators, and power users) to understand how DataMesh is used in practice, identify migration blockers, and validate decisions before they ship
* Partner with Customer Success and GTM to plan communications, enablement, and migration support for enterprise accounts that depend on DataMesh
* Work with one or more engineering squads, navigating dependencies and making clear scoping and sequencing decisions across a complex, interconnected backlog
* Author clear product briefs, requirements docs, and feature specs that design and engineering can execute on without ambiguity
* Define success metrics for everything you ship, including DataMesh usage, migration progress, and quality indicators, and partner with data and analytics teams on instrumentation and reporting
* Represent DataMesh in leadership reviews, WBRs, and customer conversations, including enterprise account engagements
* Perform other duties as assigned

**You Have:**

* 4+ years of product management experience delivering features within enterprise SaaS or B2B software products
* Experience with data management, data modelling, workflow automation, platform integrations, or cross-sheet data referencing is a strong plus
* Experience managing a mature product through sustain, deprecation, or migration phases is a plus
* Strong customer instincts: you can run structured discovery, synthesise customer feedback, and turn it into well-scoped, validated product decisions
* A track record of writing product briefs, requirements docs, and specs that engineering and design can act on without ambiguity
* Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, GTM, and Customer Success
* Comfort working with engineering teams across time zones, including stakeholders in North America
* A data-driven mindset: you define adoption and quality metrics before you ship and use post-launch data to guide iteration
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including confidence presenting in leadership reviews and speaking directly with enterprise customers
* Familiarity with API-driven product development or working alongside platform engineering teams is a plus
* Legally eligible to work in India on an ongoing basis
* Fluency in English is required

**Get to Know Us:**

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you're doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that's magic at work. Let's build what's next, together.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

**Position Overview**

  
  

Autodesk is seeking a strategic and technically skilled Senior Product Manager to lead the modernization of our Marketing Technology (MarTech) ecosystem, with a primary focus on end-to-end Lead Management and pipeline progression.

In this role, you will define and execute product strategy across the lead lifecycle, from lead capture, enrichment, scoring, qualification, routing, and engagement through pipeline progression and conversion. You will collaborate closely with Attribution, Analytics, Data, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams to ensure Lead Management capabilities are seamlessly connected across the broader MarTech ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in Marketing Technology and Lead Management with strong product management skills and a passion for leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to transform how leads are identified, qualified, prioritized, engaged, and converted.

You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Data Science, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Analytics teams to build intelligent, scalable solutions that improve lead quality, optimize seller productivity, accelerate pipeline progression, and drive revenue growth.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

  
  

* Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for the MarTech portfolio, focusing on end-to-end Lead Management and pipeline progression while aligning technology investments with business objectives
* Lead the evolution of the Lead Management ecosystem, including lead capture, lifecycle management, enrichment, deduplication, scoring, qualification, routing, prioritization, engagement, and conversion
* Own the end-to-end lead-to-revenue experience, identifying opportunities to reduce friction and optimize conversion across every stage of the sales funnel
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering teams to develop and enhance Machine Learning (ML) and predictive models for lead scoring, qualification, prioritization, and conversion
* Drive AI-powered lead engagement and qualification through AI agents, AI-powered Sales Development Representative (AI-SDR) capabilities, and Copilot solutions that automate repetitive workflows, improve lead coverage, and provide sellers with timely, actionable insights
* Define strategies to improve lead quality and enrichment by leveraging first-party and external data sources to provide relevant context for qualification, scoring, routing, and seller engagement
* Establish measurable strategies and feedback loops to continuously improve lead scoring, qualification, routing, and conversion performance
* Partner with the Marketing Attribution Product Manager to define requirements and ensure attribution capabilities support end-to-end lead-to-pipeline measurement and decision-making
* Collaborate with GTM Product Managers to drive cross-functional initiatives and ensure Lead Management capabilities integrate seamlessly across Customer Relationship Management (CRM), marketing automation, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), analytics, advertising, and other GTM systems
* Define product requirements, prioritize roadmaps, and collaborate with Engineering, User Experience (UX), Architecture, Technical Program Management, and Data teams to deliver high-impact solutions
* Leverage data, experimentation, and customer insights to identify opportunities, measure product success, and continuously improve lead-to-revenue outcomes
* Build strong relationships with Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Data Science, Finance, and executive stakeholders to align product investments with business priorities
* Champion AI innovation, experimentation, automation, and continuous improvement across the Lead Management ecosystem
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  
  

* 10+ years of Product Management experience, including significant experience in Marketing Technology, Lead Management, or Go-to-Market (GTM) technology
* Deep expertise in end-to-end Lead Management, including lead lifecycle management, enrichment, scoring, qualification, routing, prioritization, engagement, and pipeline progression
* Strong understanding of modern GTM systems, including Customer Relationship Management (CRM), marketing automation, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Business Intelligence (BI) platforms, and sales engagement technologies
* Experience developing data-driven products and collaborating with Data Science or Machine Learning teams
* Strong understanding of lead scoring methodologies, predictive models, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and marketing measurement
* Proven ability to translate complex lead-to-revenue processes and business requirements into scalable product solutions
* Experience defining and measuring product Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), experimentation frameworks, and business outcomes
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with demonstrated experience influencing senior leadership across Marketing, Sales, and Technology organizations
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, User Experience, Operations, and Business teams
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  
  

* Experience with Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, Microsoft Power BI, Adobe Experience Platform, Customer Data Platforms, or similar Marketing Technology and GTM solutions
* Experience designing and launching AI-powered user experiences, AI agents, Copilot solutions, AI-powered Sales Development Representative capabilities, or Generative AI features for enterprise applications
* Experience developing or optimizing Machine Learning-based lead scoring, predictive lead qualification, or propensity models
* Experience with lead enrichment, identity resolution, data quality, and integration of external data providers into Lead Management workflows
* Familiarity with marketing attribution, experimentation, predictive analytics, and customer journey optimization
  

  

**The Ideal Candidate**

  
  

The ideal candidate is a strategic and technically accomplished Product Management professional who combines deep Marketing Technology expertise, analytical thinking, and cross-functional leadership to modernize Lead Management capabilities and deliver measurable business outcomes

  
  

* Demonstrates strong product leadership and a clear vision for modernizing and simplifying Lead Management through scalable, integrated technology solutions
* Applies deep knowledge of lead lifecycle management, marketing automation, and GTM systems to improve lead quality, qualification, and conversion
* Uses data, experimentation, and sound judgment to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and drive measurable improvements in business performance
* Leverages Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to develop intelligent lead scoring, enrichment, qualification, prioritization, and routing capabilities
* Improves seller productivity by ensuring Sales teams receive qualified leads with relevant context at the appropriate time
* Drives AI-powered lead engagement and qualification to reduce manual effort, improve lead coverage, and accelerate response times
* Identifies and removes friction across the lead-to-pipeline journey to improve conversion rates and accelerate revenue opportunities
* Establishes closed-loop measurement and feedback mechanisms to continuously improve lead scoring, qualification, engagement, and conversion
* Builds trusted partnerships across Attribution, Analytics, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, Engineering, and GTM teams to deliver connected insights across the lead-to-revenue lifecycle
* Identifies opportunities to streamline operational processes through automation, AI-powered workflows, and scalable technology solutions
* Collaborates effectively across the GTM product portfolio to strengthen Marketing and Sales alignment and improve organizational productivity
* Influences strategic direction and serves as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders
* Demonstrates strong ownership, adaptability, and a commitment to delivering measurable improvements in lead quality, pipeline progression, conversion, and revenue growth

title: Product Manager, AI
description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.

Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.

Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.

### **How you'll make an impact:**

As a Product Manager with AI experience, you are the link between our users and our engineering team. You will work with users to understand what they need, and you will have the technical skills to work with engineers to deliver it. A key part of the role is finding where AI can save our customers time and effort in inventory management, and turning those opportunities into features that enterprise users love and trust.

You will explore and shape product ideas by interviewing customers, studying competitors, and testing new technology, including AI models, tools, and open source options. There are many good ideas, but only some can be built. You will work with UX, engineering, and leadership to choose the ones that matter most, and to decide where AI is the right answer and where a simpler solution works better.

### **What you'll do:**

* Turn business goals into clear software requirements.
* Find and define AI use cases for Core, such as forecasting, data entry, search, and automation of routine tasks, and write the requirements for each.
* Rank features based on market research, customer need, and company strategy.
* Manage project scope by making trade-offs between time and cost, and between security and speed.
* Set success measures for AI features, such as accuracy, time saved, and user adoption, and track them after launch.
* Work with engineers to decide how to build, test, and monitor AI features, including how we handle wrong or unexpected results.
* Work with Security, Legal, and Engineering to handle customer data responsibly in AI features, including privacy, data use, and cost of running the models.
* Rank feature requests from the development teams.
* Set the product vision and work closely with the technical team to define specifications.
* Make sure the product meets business goals and user needs.
* Track progress against plan and fix variances as soon as they appear.
* Make trade-offs between features, schedule, and cost, based on business goals, company policies, software architecture, and team capacity.

### **What you'll bring:**

* Proven work experience in product management or as an associate product manager, preferably in B2B SaaS, with inventory management, supply chain, or ecommerce domain experience a plus.
* Hands-on experience shipping at least one product or feature that uses AI or machine learning, including large language models.
* Working understanding of how AI features are built and tested, such as prompts, model selection, evaluation, accuracy, and data quality. You do not need to write code.
* Awareness of AI risks, including incorrect answers, bias, privacy, and cost, and how to reduce them.
* Proven track record of managing a successful product through its full lifecycle.
* Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and present recommendations to executive management.
* Structured approach and experience with agile methods.
* History of working with development teams to get results.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up your sleeves.
* Skilled at working with cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Enthusiasm for new technology and a practical view of what it can and cannot do.
* Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

### **Why Work for Us?**

* We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth.
* You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
* Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
* Recruitment referral bonus
* Work for a Great Place to Work®

**Why CIN7?**

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.

At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.

***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team.***

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
